crossRefs.note: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may…
Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers…
one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter…
Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
“You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.
Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
“Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;
“You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die.…
None of the priests shall drink wine when they enter into the inner court.

translations.web: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
translations.bsb: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued or given to much wine or greedy for money.
translations.kjv: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
translations.asv: Deacons in like manner must be grave, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
